verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is an incorporation platform, so post-incorporation founder setup is a fair question for it. Its post-incorporation services cover German statutory filings: Transparenzregister entry, trade registration and tax registration via ELSTER. The evidence never mentions founder stock purchase agreements, IP assignment documents or 83(b) elections, so those filings are only an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete post-incorporation setup — founder stock purchases, IP assignment, and 83(b) elections — with correct standard paperwork
